observations: All six layers remain in the warm charcoal/matte warm-gray hue family. Conditional same-luminance color medians are similar, mostly R-B7..11; no strong blue/brown chromatic split observed.
Style01 front and rear are visibly grayer/lighter and have raised shadows versus original and styles02/03. This difference is visible in nine-pair review rather than inferred from a single mean.
Front02/rear01 and front03/rear01 expose lighter gray crown/bun at the rear; front01/rear02 and front01/rear03 expose the lighter front mass against deeper rear shading.
Style03 has somewhat stronger bright strand contrast than original, with retained dark troughs; this is a contrast/strand-density difference, not a hue mismatch.
recommendation: A restrained tone unification pass is justified for style01 front and rear. Use a smooth monotonic luminance curve that deepens lifted shadows/midtones while retaining relative highlights, alpha, outlines and real strand contrast. Judge front/rear exposed meeting zones on both backgrounds afterward. Do not map each whole-layer mean or full histogram to one number, and do not brighten all rear shadows to front intensity. Styles02/03 do not need an automatic mean-equalizing pass.
limits: Spatially shared crown ROI samples differing folds and braids, so quantiles support but do not alone establish a recoloring target. No visual approval or numerical color acceptance threshold is claimed.
